data.name: AppDisplayName
data.comment: Product name, shown in the window title. Keep it in English unless the product is known by another name in the language.

data.name: NavigationHome
data.comment: Navigation item for the page that lists the features.

data.name: NavigationGeneral
data.comment: Navigation item for the app-wide settings page.

data.name: TraySettings
data.comment: Tray icon menu command that opens the settings window.

data.name: TrayExit
data.comment: Tray icon menu command that stops PC Companion running in the background.

data.name: UpdateNotificationTitle
data.comment: Title of the notification shown when a newer version is available. {0} is the version number, for example 1.2.0. "PC Companion" is the product name. At most 63 characters with the version.

data.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
data.value: Select to open its release page, where you can download it.
data.comment: Text of the notification shown when a newer version is available; selecting it opens the release page on GitHub. At most 255 characters.

data.name: GeneralLanguageHeader
data.comment: General page: setting for the user interface language.

data.name: GeneralLanguageDescription
data.value: Restart the app to see a new language.
data.comment: General page: below GeneralLanguageHeader.

data.name: GeneralLanguageWindows
data.comment: General page: language choice that follows the Windows display language.

data.name: GeneralThemeHeader
data.comment: General page: setting for light or dark colors.

data.name: GeneralThemeDescription
data.value: Choose which theme the app uses.
data.comment: General page: below GeneralThemeHeader.

data.name: GeneralThemeSystem
data.comment: General page: theme choice that follows the Windows app mode.

data.name: GeneralThemeLight
data.comment: General page: theme choice.

data.name: GeneralThemeDark
data.comment: General page: theme choice.

data.name: GeneralStartupHeader
data.comment: General page: on/off setting.

data.name: GeneralStartupDescription
data.value: Run PC Companion in the background when you sign in.
data.comment: General page: below GeneralStartupHeader. "PC Companion" is the product name.

data.name: GeneralRunAsAdministratorHeader
data.comment: General page: setting name.

data.name: GeneralRunAsAdministratorDescription
data.value: Lets features work while an app running as administrator is in front. Windows asks for permission when you turn this on or off.
data.comment: General page: below GeneralRunAsAdministratorHeader.

data.name: GeneralRunAsAdministratorNeedsAllUsers
data.value: Available when PC Companion is installed for all users.
data.comment: General page: instead of GeneralRunAsAdministratorDescription when PC Companion is installed for one user only.

data.name: GeneralRunAsAdministratorNeedsAdministrator
data.comment: General page: instead of GeneralRunAsAdministratorDescription when the user's account isn't an administrator.

data.name: GeneralRunAsAdministratorFailed
data.value: Always run as administrator couldn't be changed. Try again.
data.comment: General page: shown when turning the setting on or off failed.

data.name: GeneralRunAsAdministratorHostWithoutAdminRights
data.value: PC Companion is running in the background without admin rights, so features don't work while an app running as administrator is in front. To fix this, turn Always run as administrator off and on again, or sign out and back in.
data.comment: General page warning: Always run as administrator is on, but the background host couldn't start as administrator.

data.name: GeneralLogsHeader
data.comment: General page: diagnostic log files.

data.name: GeneralLogsOpen
data.comment: General page: button that opens the folder with the log files.

data.name: GeneralLogsOpenHost
data.comment: General page: button that opens the folder of the background host's logs, shown while Always run as administrator is on.

data.name: GeneralDetailedLoggingHeader
data.comment: General page: on/off setting that adds more detail to the log files.

data.name: GeneralDetailedLoggingDescription_one
data.value: Adds more detail to the logs for {0} hour, to help find a problem.
data.comment: Plural form "one". General page: below GeneralDetailedLoggingHeader while it is off. {0} is the number of hours.

data.name: GeneralDetailedLoggingDescription_other
data.value: Adds more detail to the logs for {0} hours, to help find a problem.
data.comment: Plural form "other". General page: below GeneralDetailedLoggingHeader while it is off. {0} is the number of hours.

data.name: GeneralDetailedLoggingOnUntil
data.comment: General page: below GeneralDetailedLoggingHeader while it is on. {0} is the date and time it turns off, in the user's regional format.

data.name: GeneralAboutHeader
data.comment: General page: information about the app.

data.name: GeneralAboutVersion
data.comment: General page: {0} is the version number, for example 1.2.0.

data.name: GeneralSaveFailed
data.value: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
data.comment: General page: shown when the settings file can't be written.

data.name: GeneralLogsRetention_one
data.comment: Plural form "one". {0} is the number of days.

data.name: GeneralLogsRetention_other
data.comment: Plural form "other". {0} is the number of days.

data.name: ModuleInputName
data.comment: Navigation pane and Home: the group of features that respond to the mouse and keyboard.

data.name: ModuleWindowsName
data.comment: Navigation pane and Home: the group of features that arrange and switch windows.

data.name: FeatureSaveFailed
data.value: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
data.comment: Home and feature pages: shown when the settings file can't be written.

data.name: FeatureNotAvailable
data.comment: Home: instead of a feature's description when this PC can't run the feature.

data.name: FeaturePermissionsHeader
data.comment: Feature pages: card that says what the feature reads and changes.

data.name: HotCornersName
data.comment: Feature name: navigation pane, Home and the Hot Corners page.

data.name: HotCornersDescription
data.value: Move the pointer into a corner of the screen to run an action, such as showing all windows or locking the PC.
data.comment: Hot Corners: one-sentence description below the feature name.

data.name: HotCornersCornersHeader
data.comment: Hot Corners page: card with a picture of a screen and a list of actions for each of its corners.

data.name: HotCornersCornersDescription
data.value: Choose what each corner does. To avoid running an action by accident, choose a key to hold.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: below HotCornersCornersHeader.

data.name: HotCornersTopLeft
data.comment: Hot Corners page: a physical corner of the screen, the same in right-to-left languages.

data.name: HotCornersTopRight
data.comment: Hot Corners page: a physical corner of the screen, the same in right-to-left languages.

data.name: HotCornersBottomLeft
data.comment: Hot Corners page: a physical corner of the screen, the same in right-to-left languages.

data.name: HotCornersBottomRight
data.comment: Hot Corners page: a physical corner of the screen, the same in right-to-left languages.

data.name: HotCornersActionName
data.comment: Hot Corners page: screen reader name of a corner's list of actions. {0} is a corner, such as HotCornersTopLeft.

data.name: HotCornersKeyName
data.comment: Hot Corners page: screen reader name of a corner's list of keys to hold. {0} is a corner, such as HotCornersTopLeft.

data.name: HotCornersActionNone
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the corner does nothing.

data.name: HotCornersActionTaskView
data.comment: Hot Corners action: the Windows feature that shows all open windows and virtual desktops. Use the Windows term.

data.name: HotCornersActionShowDesktop
data.comment: Hot Corners action: use the Windows term.

data.name: HotCornersActionStart
data.comment: Hot Corners action: opens Start. Use the Windows term.

data.name: HotCornersActionSearch
data.comment: Hot Corners action: opens Windows search. Use the Windows term.

data.name: HotCornersActionNotifications
data.comment: Hot Corners action: opens the notification center (Windows 11) or the Action center (Windows 10).

data.name: HotCornersActionLock
data.comment: Hot Corners action: locks the PC, as the Lock command in Start does.

data.name: HotCornersActionTurnOffDisplays
data.comment: Hot Corners action: the displays stay off until the pointer moves or a key is pressed.

data.name: HotCornersActionScreenSaver
data.comment: Hot Corners action: starts the screen saver chosen in Windows settings.

data.name: HotCornersActionKeepDisplaysOn
data.comment: Hot Corners action: while the pointer stays in the corner, the screen saver doesn't start and the displays don't turn off.

data.name: HotCornersKeepDisplaysOnReason
data.value: Hot Corners: the pointer is in a corner that keeps the displays on.
data.comment: Reason shown by powercfg /requests while a Hot Corners corner keeps the displays on.

data.name: HotCornersActionRunProgram
data.comment: Hot Corners action: starts the program chosen for the corner.

data.name: HotCornersKeyNone
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the corner doesn't need a key.

data.name: HotCornersKeyControl
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the corner runs its action only while the key is held. Use the key name printed on keyboards in the language.

data.name: HotCornersKeyAlt
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the corner runs its action only while the key is held. Use the key name printed on keyboards in the language.

data.name: HotCornersKeyShift
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the corner runs its action only while the key is held. Use the key name printed on keyboards in the language.

data.name: HotCornersKeyWindows
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the corner runs its action only while the key is held. Use the Windows term for the key.

data.name: HotCornersProgramHeader
data.comment: Hot Corners page, Run a program: label of the box with the program's full path.

data.name: HotCornersArgumentsHeader
data.comment: Hot Corners page, Run a program: label of the box with the program's arguments.

data.name: HotCornersBrowse
data.comment: Hot Corners page, Run a program: button that opens the Open dialog. Use the Windows term.

data.name: HotCornersProgramName
data.comment: Hot Corners page: screen reader name of a corner's program box. {0} is a corner, such as HotCornersTopLeft.

data.name: HotCornersArgumentsName
data.comment: Hot Corners page: screen reader name of a corner's arguments box. {0} is a corner, such as HotCornersTopLeft.

data.name: HotCornersBrowseName
data.comment: Hot Corners page: screen reader name of a corner's Browse button. {0} is a corner, such as HotCornersTopLeft.

data.name: HotCornersProgramDialogTitle
data.comment: Title of the Open dialog for a corner's program.

data.name: HotCornersProgramFilter
data.comment: Open dialog: the name of the .exe file type.

data.name: HotCornersProgramNotChosen
data.comment: Hot Corners page: shown below a corner's program box while it's empty.

data.name: HotCornersProgramNotFullPath
data.value: Enter the full path, such as C:\Program Files\App\App.exe.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: shown when the program isn't a full path. Keep the example path as it is.

data.name: HotCornersProgramNotExe
data.comment: Hot Corners page: shown when the program isn't an .exe file.

data.name: HotCornersProgramNotFound
data.comment: Hot Corners page: shown when the program's file doesn't exist.

data.name: HotCornersProgramNote
data.value: Starts with your rights. Doesn't run while PC Companion runs as administrator.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: below a corner's program and arguments.

data.name: HotCornersDelayHeader
data.comment: Hot Corners page: setting name.

data.name: HotCornersDelayDescription
data.value: How long the pointer stays in a corner before the action runs.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: below HotCornersDelayHeader.

data.name: HotCornersDelayValue
data.comment: Hot Corners page: the activation delay. {0} is a number of milliseconds; use the usual abbreviation.

data.name: HotCornersFullScreenHeader
data.value: Don't trigger when an app is full screen
data.comment: Hot Corners page: setting name. On by default.

data.name: HotCornersFullScreenDescription
data.value: For example, a game, a video or a presentation.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: below HotCornersFullScreenHeader.

data.name: HotCornersAdministratorInfo
data.value: Corners don't work while an app running as administrator is in front.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: a limitation of Windows, shown at all times.

data.name: HotCornersAdministratorInfoOn
data.value: PC Companion runs as administrator, so corners also work while an app running as administrator is in front. Run a program doesn't run.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: replaces HotCornersAdministratorInfo while Always run as administrator is on. "Run a program" is HotCornersActionRunProgram.

data.name: HotCornersPermissions
data.value: Reads the pointer position, and whether a mouse button or the chosen key is held, only while Hot Corners is on. Sends only the Windows shortcuts of the chosen actions, and starts only the programs you choose. Stores and sends nothing.
data.comment: Hot Corners page: below FeaturePermissionsHeader.

data.name: AppWindowsName
data.comment: Feature name: switching between the windows of the app in front.

data.name: AppWindowsDescription
data.value: Switch between the windows of the app in front with a keyboard shortcut, such as between File Explorer windows.
data.comment: App Windows: the feature description, on its page and its Home card.

data.name: AppWindowsShortcutHeader
data.comment: App Windows page: setting name, and the screen reader name of its list.

data.name: AppWindowsShortcutDescription
data.value: Press it again to go on to the next window of the app. Add Shift to go the other way. The key is the one above Tab, left of 1.
data.comment: App Windows page: below AppWindowsShortcutHeader. The key is found by its position on the keyboard, whatever character it types.

data.name: AppWindowsShortcutAlt
data.comment: App Windows page: a shortcut in the list. {0} is the character the key above Tab types in the user's keyboard layout, such as ` or ^, or AppWindowsKeyAboveTab.

data.name: AppWindowsShortcutWindows
data.comment: App Windows page: a shortcut in the list. {0} is the character the key above Tab types in the user's keyboard layout, such as ` or ^, or AppWindowsKeyAboveTab.

data.name: AppWindowsKeyAboveTab
data.comment: App Windows page: used in AppWindowsShortcutAlt and AppWindowsShortcutWindows when the key types no character that can be shown.

data.name: AppWindowsMinimizedHeader
data.comment: App Windows page: setting name. Off by default.

data.name: AppWindowsMinimizedDescription
data.value: A minimized window is restored when its turn comes.
data.comment: App Windows page: below AppWindowsMinimizedHeader.

data.name: AppWindowsShortcutInfo
data.value: Other apps don't get this shortcut while App Windows is on. With the Microsoft Japanese IME, Alt + the key above Tab stays with the IME, so choose the Windows logo key.
data.comment: App Windows page: shown at all times.

data.name: AppWindowsAdministratorInfo
data.value: App Windows doesn't work while an app running as administrator is in front.
data.comment: App Windows page: a limitation of Windows, shown while Always run as administrator is off.

data.name: AppWindowsAdministratorInfoOn
data.value: PC Companion runs as administrator, so App Windows also works while an app running as administrator is in front.
data.comment: App Windows page: shown instead of AppWindowsAdministratorInfo while Always run as administrator is on.

data.name: AppWindowsPermissions
data.value: When you press the shortcut, reads which windows are open, their state and which app they belong to, and while App Windows is on, the keyboard layout of the window in front. Never reads window titles or contents. Changes only which of the app's windows is in front. Stores and sends nothing.
data.comment: App Windows page: below FeaturePermissionsHeader.
